tasks.title: match library API
expectations: Match ids are validated by one function before any file access, so path traversal is impossible
Writes to the store are atomic (write to a temporary file, then rename); a crash cannot leave a half-written match
The router contains no business logic; MatchStore holds it
All error responses go through one helper that returns the error body and the right status
The analytics module is imported lazily and its result is cached on disk
Every public function or exported name has a short docstring or comment that states inputs, output and units
No function is longer than 60 lines and none does more than one job

tasks.title: match library application
expectations: Importing the library app never imports torch, cv2, numpy or the live pipeline
The README section describes only behaviour that exists in the code
The existing serve and run commands behave exactly as before
Every public function or exported name has a short docstring or comment that states inputs, output and units
No function is longer than 60 lines and none does more than one job
